resources.string: Only accept messages from known contacts
Hide app activity from lock screen

If this passcode is ever entered at the lock screen, all data on this device is permanently wiped and the app opens into a fresh account seeded with plausible everyday conversations, so it looks like it worked normally. Choose something distinct from your real passcode.
No session with that contact yet
Create your private, post-quantum encrypted identity. No phone number, no email.

The passcode is optional. Without one NiiX opens straight away; with one (at least 8 digits) nothing can be read without it. You can change this later in Settings. The duress passcode, also optional, wipes everything if it\'s entered at unlock.
A duress passcode only works together with a passcode
deriving key from passcode (Argon2id, 64 MiB) and creating the encrypted database
generating identity keys and Kyber-1024 prekeys
done; Tor connects in the background
deriving key (Argon2id, 64 MiB) and opening the database
Username (others may share the same name)
Duress passcode must be 6+ digits and different from your passcode
Compare this number with your contact in person or over a trusted channel. If it matches on both devices, your conversation is verified end-to-end.
Paste the share code from the person you want to add. You can get yours from menu → My code.
Your address appears once the network connects (Tor).
Point the camera at a NiiX QR code
Only receive messages from people you have added.
Keeps the ongoing notification off your lock screen. Message notifications never show the sender or content.
A separate passcode that silently wipes everything.
Save an encrypted copy of your messages and keys.
Checks GitHub for new versions. No other network activity.
Nothing can reach this device while the app is locked. Messages arrive when you unlock.
Routes update checks through Tor. Slower, but hides that this device runs NiiX. Messages always use Tor.
Off. Let nominated contacts erase this device remotely.
On. %1$d nominated contact(s) can erase this device.

When on, a contact you nominate can erase this device remotely.

Only contacts you nominate can do this, and they are told when you nominate them. Revoking takes effect immediately.

Nothing is ever sent back, so the sender can't tell whether it worked, or even whether this device exists.
Can\'t verify yet. Exchange a message with this contact first.
No contact has nominated this device to erase theirs.\n\nThey have to nominate you in their own settings first. You cannot wipe a device that has not asked you to.
This will ask %1$s to erase everything on their device.\n\nIt cannot be undone, and you won\'t get any confirmation either way: a wiped device looks exactly like one that\'s switched off.
Request sent. There is no confirmation by design.
Exchange a message with this contact first, so the permission can be tied to their identity.
Removed. They can no longer erase this device.
Nominated. They can now erase this device.
Skip the confirmation on the wipe button. Faster in an emergency, easier to hit by accident.
New messages stay hidden until tapped. Revealing one starts its disappearing timer.
This is the name your contacts see. It isn\'t an identity. Two people can use the same name, and changing it doesn\'t change who you are to anyone. Your contacts are told the new name straight away.
Name changed. Your contacts have been told.
Tap the photo to see it larger
Tap the photo to add one
Tap to show it full size, or to copy your share code
Remove your profile photo? Your contacts will see your initial instead.
No browser available to open the link

Opens the issues page on GitHub in your browser

NiiX is free and has no funding behind it. If it is useful to you, this is the Monero address:

%1$s

Check the address against the one on the project page before sending anything. Nobody is asked to donate, and nothing in the app changes if you do.
Recent activity, kept in memory only. Erased when the app locks.
Not connected to Tor yet. Wait for the connection to finish, then try again.
Every release is cryptographically signed; an update is never installed if that signature doesn\'t check out.
Not connected yet. New messages will arrive once the connection is up.
Still checking. Anything new will appear when it arrives.
Restore your data from an encrypted backup.
⚠ Unverified identity: check the safety number
Only a group admin can change the group photo
Remove this group\'s photo for everyone?
// no groups yet, tap + to create

Scan a contact\'s QR code from their My code screen.
When off, screenshots and screen recording are blocked inside the app.
Needed to type Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Thai. The phone\'s keyboard can see what you type; NiiX asks it not to learn from it, but can\'t make it.
When someone is offline, their messages wait on public Nostr relays until they come back. Relays only ever see encrypted data under a changing label, reached over Tor.
Where your contacts leave messages for you while you are offline. Your contacts are told when this changes.
One relay per line, e.g. wss://relay.example.com

Every relay is reached through Tor, so relays never see your IP address. Use wss:// addresses, or ws:// for .onion relays. Up to six. Changes are sent to contacts the next time each is reachable; until then they may still leave messages on the old relays.
No valid relays: offline delivery to you is paused
Send decoy messages so an observer cannot tell when you are really chatting. Uses a little extra battery and data.
Recording... tap to stop and send

%1$s will be decrypted and saved to your Downloads folder.\n\nOnce saved it is an ordinary file: other apps can read it, it is not covered by the duress wipe, and it stays on the device if NiiX is removed.
Microphone permission is needed to record audio
Your name, photo and share code
Blur, screenshots, keyboard, cover traffic, who can reach you
Export and restore an encrypted copy
How NiiX checks for and installs new versions
Shown to your contacts. Location and other metadata are removed automatically.
Only group admins can do that
Remove this group and its messages from this device
You\'ll stop receiving messages from this group, and it will be removed from this device. Other members keep their copy.
Camera permission is needed to take a photo
This removes the conversation and its messages from this device. %1$s stays in your contacts, and you can message them again anytime.
This removes the group and its messages from this device. Your contacts are not affected.
Too many attempts. Try again in %1$s.
Without this, anyone who can unlock your phone can open NiiX directly.
Immediately and permanently erases everything on this device.

Without a passcode, anyone who can unlock your phone (with a fingerprint, face or screen lock) can open NiiX directly and read your messages. Your data stays encrypted, but only as strongly as your phone\'s own lock screen, not by anything only you know.\n\nYour duress code will stop working, since there\'s no passcode screen left to enter it into. You can wipe your data manually from Settings instead.
This immediately and permanently deletes all messages, contacts, and keys on this device. This cannot be undone.
Couldn\'t change this setting. Nothing was changed, try again.

Could not reach the update server over Tor
Unexpected response from the update server
The release has no app file
The release isn\'t signed, so it isn\'t offered
Signature verification failed. The update was rejected and deleted.
The update didn\'t save correctly. Nothing was installed; please try again.
The downloaded update is missing or empty.
Android blocked the installation%1$s. On some phones you need to allow this app to install unknown apps, in Settings › Apps › Special access.

This update conflicts with the installed version%1$s. That usually means it was signed with a different key than the app on this device, which Android never accepts as an update. Export a backup from Settings first, then uninstall and install fresh; after that, updates will work.
This update isn\'t compatible with this device%1$s.
Android rejected the update file as invalid%1$s. If the version number isn\'t higher than the installed one, that\'s the usual cause.
Not enough free storage to install the update%1$s.
Ready. Scan this code from your other device.

On a device that already has your account, open Settings › Security › Linked devices, tap \"Link a new device\" and scan this code. Your contacts and groups are copied over; message history stays where it is.
Linked. Your contacts and groups are here.
Use this account on more than one device
Each device has its own address and keys, and gets every message. Removing a device erases it and stops contacts sending to it. A wipe on any device, including the duress passcode, wipes them all.
It will be told to erase everything, and your contacts stop sending to it. If it was lost or taken, it still holds what it had already received.
That isn\'t a link code. Scan the code shown on the new device.
This account is already on %1$d devices
Couldn\'t reach the new device. Keep its code on screen and try again.
Scan the code on the new device
Link this device to another account

resources.string: Messages from these people are dropped without them being told. Tap someone to unblock them.
Their messages will arrive again. Anything they sent while blocked is gone.
The other phone gets this account\'s key, your contacts and groups, and every message from now on. Only link a phone you own and control.
Not verified. Compare safety numbers to be sure it\'s them.
Off. Erases this device if NiiX goes unused for a set time.

Erases this device if NiiX hasn\'t been unlocked or used for this long, even with no network. It happens the next time NiiX opens or runs after the time is up. Your other linked devices aren\'t erased. Winding the phone\'s clock back doesn\'t stop it; only time the phone spends switched off with its clock wound back isn\'t counted.

Android stopped NiiX in the background for about %1$s, so messages sent to you waited until now. Letting NiiX run without battery restrictions prevents this. On Samsung phones, also check that NiiX isn\'t listed under Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps.
Tell contacts when I\'m back online
After you reconnect, your contacts get a tiny message so their phones send what was waiting for you straight away. Off by default: it lets them know when you come online.

On Samsung phones this is usually Auto Blocker, which only allows apps from the Galaxy Store and Play Store. Turn it off in Settings › Security and privacy › Auto Blocker, update, then turn it back on if you like.
Messages are deleted from both phones when the time runs out. This can\'t stop the other person taking a screenshot, photographing the screen or copying the text before then.
Remove %1$s from the group? They stop getting its messages, and the group\'s keys are changed so they can\'t read anything sent after this.
Changes every colour in NiiX and its icon. Some home screens move the icon back into the app list when it changes, so you may need to put it back on your home screen.

%1$s will be able to call you once they allow calls with you too. Either of you can stop it at any time.\n\nCalls are end-to-end encrypted and go over Tor like your messages, so neither of you sees the other\'s IP address. Tor adds about a second of delay.
Calls allowed. They can be made once the other person allows them too.
Voice calls are only possible with contacts whose safety number you\'ve verified. Check it with them first.
%1$s hasn\'t allowed calls with you yet
Calls aren\'t possible in this chat yet
Read it to each other. If it matches, nobody is in between.

For a call to stay on screen until you answer or decline it, NiiX needs permission to show full-screen notifications. Without it, Android hides an incoming call after a few seconds, though it keeps ringing in the notification shade.\n\nIn the next screen, turn on full-screen notifications for NiiX.
Notifications are off for NiiX, so incoming calls can\'t ring. Turn them on to be able to answer calls.
Also offers test versions marked as pre-releases on GitHub. They\'re signed like every release, but may have more bugs. Turning this off never goes back to an older version.
Calls will now stay on screen until you answer

Full-screen notifications are still off for NiiX.

Look in Settings › Apps › Special app access › Full screen notifications, and turn NiiX on. On some phones it's under Apps › NiiX › Other permissions, as "Show on lock screen" or "Full-screen notifications".

Calls still ring without it: the banner comes back every few seconds until you answer.
Notifications are still off for NiiX, so calls can\'t ring. Look in Settings › Apps › NiiX › Notifications and turn them on.
